🧹 Nitpick comments (2)
test/extended-priv/inside_node_containers.go (2)
`100-102`: _🔒 Security & Privacy_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _💤 Low value_ **Shell commands built via string concatenation into `bash -c`.** `proxyEnvPrefix()` and its callers (`buildImage()`, `pushImage()`, `digestImage()`) construct commands by concatenating proxy values, paths and image names, then execute them with `bash -c`. Proxy values originate from the cluster's trusted `Proxy` CR rather than external user input, which limits practical exploitability here, but this is exactly the pattern flagged by the injection-prevention guideline for Go.
🛡️ Illustrative alternative (avoid shell interpretation) ```diff -buildCommand := b.proxyEnvPrefix() + " podman build --network host " + buildPath + " " + imageFlag + " " + b.osImage + " --authfile " + b.remoteDockerConfig -output, err := b.node.DebugNodeWithChroot("bash", "-c", buildCommand) +output, err := b.node.DebugNodeWithChrootEnv( + map[string]string{"NO_PROXY": b.noProxy, "HTTPS_PROXY": b.httpsProxy, "HTTP_PROXY": b.httpProxy}, + "podman", "build", "--network", "host", buildPath, imageFlag, b.osImage, "--authfile", b.remoteDockerConfig, +) ```
As per path instructions, `**/*.{py,js,ts,go,rs,java,rb,php,kt,swift,cs}`: "Command: no shell=True, os.system, or backtick exec with user input... Validate at trust boundaries with allow-lists, not deny-lists." Also applies to: 315-328, 345-363, 395-401
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. In `@test/extended-priv/inside_node_containers.go` around lines 100 - 102, The shell command construction in proxyEnvPrefix() and its callers buildImage(), pushImage(), and digestImage() is using string concatenation and then passing the result to bash -c, which should be avoided. Refactor these paths to execute commands without a shell by passing arguments directly to the command runner and handling proxy values, paths, and image names as separate parameters, using allow-list validation where needed instead of concatenating them into one shell string. ```
_Source: Path instructions_ --- `255-277`: _🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Remote temp-dir cleanup added to `CleanUp()`, but most callers never invoke `CleanUp()`.** This is a real improvement, but 8+ existing test call sites across `mco_alerts.go`, `mco_daemon.go`, `mco_layering.go`, `mco_ocb.go`, and `mco_osimagestream.go` never call `osImageBuilder.CleanUp()` (only two spots in `mco_layering.go` do, both for internal-registry builds). For those tests, the newly added `remoteTmpDir` removal (lines 258-263) will never execute, so remote temp directories will continue to accumulate on nodes across repeated test runs — the same as before this change, just with an unused cleanup capability now available. Also, the `else` branch message "Not using internal registry, nothing to clean" (line 274) is stale now since `remoteTmpDir` cleanup already ran unconditionally above it.
♻️ Suggested tweak for the stale message ```diff - } else { - logger.Infof("Not using internal registry, nothing to clean") - } + } else { + logger.Infof("Not using internal registry, no namespace to clean") + } ```
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. In `@test/extended-priv/inside_node_containers.go` around lines 255 - 277, `OsImageBuilderInNode.CleanUp()` now removes `remoteTmpDir`, but most test call sites still never invoke it, so the new cleanup path is unused. Update the relevant callers in `mco_alerts.go`, `mco_daemon.go`, `mco_layering.go`, `mco_ocb.go`, and `mco_osimagestream.go` to call `osImageBuilder.CleanUp()` in their teardown/finally paths, and keep the existing internal-registry cleanup behavior intact. Also adjust the `CleanUp()` log message in the `useInternalRegistry` else branch to reflect that remote temp-dir cleanup already happened unconditionally. ```
🤖 Prompt for all review comments with AI agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. Nitpick comments: In `@test/extended-priv/inside_node_containers.go`: - Around line 100-102: The shell command construction in proxyEnvPrefix() and its callers buildImage(), pushImage(), and digestImage() is using string concatenation and then passing the result to bash -c, which should be avoided. Refactor these paths to execute commands without a shell by passing arguments directly to the command runner and handling proxy values, paths, and image names as separate parameters, using allow-list validation where needed instead of concatenating them into one shell string. - Around line 255-277: `OsImageBuilderInNode.CleanUp()` now removes `remoteTmpDir`, but most test call sites still never invoke it, so the new cleanup path is unused. Update the relevant callers in `mco_alerts.go`, `mco_daemon.go`, `mco_layering.go`, `mco_ocb.go`, and `mco_osimagestream.go` to call `osImageBuilder.CleanUp()` in their teardown/finally paths, and keep the existing internal-registry cleanup behavior intact. Also adjust the `CleanUp()` log message in the `useInternalRegistry` else branch to reflect that remote temp-dir cleanup already happened unconditionally. ```
